attendance_policy: Minimum 75% attendance mandatory in lectures and laboratory sessions to appear in end-semester examinations.
anti_ragging: Zero-tolerance policy towards ragging. Mandatory anti-ragging affidavits submitted annually. Strict disciplinary actions including expulsion and FIR under national anti-ragging laws.
academic_probation: Students securing CGPA < 5.0 are placed on academic probation with reduced credit registration and faculty advisor monitoring.
